milestone: DDD Infrastructure Layer + Documentation Organization System
achievements: Built complete Infrastructure Layer for DDD architecture
Implemented EventBus with Observer pattern for loose coupling
Created Supabase client foundation for persistence

specificContribution.contribution: EventBus implementation enabling event-driven architecture across all 7 domains
specificContribution.impact: Loose coupling via domain events - 13 events flowing through system. Automated doc organization reducing root clutter by 87%
specificContribution.quote: The EventBus is like the ship's communication system - every domain can talk without direct coupling. And keeping the root directory clean? That's just good engineering!

lessonsLearned: EventBus enables loose coupling - domains communicate via events
Documentation organization prevents root directory bloat
RAG-verified pruning ensures knowledge never lost
Safety first: Always verify before delete (90-day retention + RAG check)

documentation_organization.when: After each session or when root has >10 .md files
documentation_organization.result: Moves docs to docs/active/ or docs/archive/

rag_verified_pruning.when: Monthly (1st of month) + 90 days after archival
rag_verified_pruning.safety: Only deletes if content verified in Supabase RAG
